sloka: गुणवत्यपि तु स्नेहात्पुत्र वक्ष्यामि ते हितम् ।भूयो विनयमास्थाय भव नित्यं जितेन्द्रियः ॥२-३-४२॥
transliteration: guṇavatyapi tu snehātputra vakṣyāmi te hitam ।bhūyo vinayamāsthāya bhava nityaṁ jitendriyaḥ ॥2-3-42॥

translations.english: With humility, always keep your senses under control. Keep off all violations arising out of lust and anger.
